name: agentmemory-offline
description: Persistent project memory with a loopback-only MCP bridge and local lifecycle capture.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent project memory stored only on this machine
interface.longDescription: Captures project sessions through local lifecycle hooks and exposes recall tools through a loopback-only MCP bridge. Memory remains under ~/.agentmemory and no cloud account or remote memory service is used.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recall relevant local project context before continuing this task.
